caption: The drawing depicts a two-piece outfit consisting of a long-sleeved, dark brown jacket with buttons down the front and a short, upright collar, paired with light-colored, vertically striped trousers. The jacket appears slightly flared at the waist and the sleeves are extended to full length. The trousers are straight-legged and the stripes are a beige or light brown on a white or off-white background, giving them a textured look. Both articles of clothing are shown without a body or mannequin, simply floating against a plain, light tan background. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, simple line drawing of the same outfit, showing the overall shape and structure in an outline form. There are no additional objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Boy's Suit
